# Automation catalogue by vendor and technology

<!-- Generated by Automation/tools/build_catalogue.py from the README front matter. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every automation, grouped by the vendor and technology it connects to. An automation that uses several vendors appears under each one, next to the technology it uses from that vendor. The same data is in [catalogue.json](catalogue.json); the fields are described in [METADATA.md](METADATA.md).
